title: Edgar Mitchell's psi experiments on the way to the moon

tellings.quote: and a lot of the astronauts did remote viewing. I mean, Edgar Mitchell is really known for that. Doing experiments when he was up on the moon and

plain: The Apollo 14 astronaut Edgar Mitchell is said to have run experiments in psychic perception during his 1971 trip to the moon. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, while saying that a lot of astronauts did remote viewing, the practice of trying to see distant places or things with the mind alone, and that Mitchell is "really known for that." If true, it would mean such experiments were being tried even in space.
